## Statistical tests
```
One-way ANOVA, popularity across platforms: F=0.22, p=0.880
Kruskal-Wallis, popularity across platforms: H=0.79, p=0.853
Spearman, tempo vs popularity: rho=0.08, p=0.352
Spearman, release year vs popularity: rho=0.08, p=0.336
Welch t-test, mid-tempo (90-110 BPM) vs other tracks: means 89.50 vs 90.95, t=-2.56, p=0.012
Mann-Whitney U, mid-tempo vs other tracks: p=0.012
Same t-test without the outlier track 'Beatbox Battle': means 89.85 vs 90.95, p=0.015
Popularity range in the data: 70 to 98 (mean 90.4, sd 3.2)
Rule: p < 0.05 = statistically significant.
```
